body: I directly inspected Rune Coliseum combat in the existing Viras/Slayer Lv3 run and added a new dated C17 entry. Verified side-on spatial combat, numbered distance lane, visible units, immediate health/resources/statuses, and a persistent dense card/loadout field. It is player-gated rather than auto-battling: I selected one green shield card, targeted the player, and observed a blue shield effect; no enemy response occurred during five seconds without an explicit advance. Recommendation: borrow clear spatial context and selected-to-targeted-to-applied feedback only; do not import its full deck-hand, turn-gated pacing, or fantasy grammar into autonomous FightCamp bouts.
topic: C17 follow-up: verified Rune Coliseum combat
